title: A remote-write effect consumes exactly one exact Owner authorization
statement: Every remote-write effect MUST consume exactly one unexpired, unrevoked Owner authorization whose action, effect, resource, repository, candidate, consuming role, and consent equal the invocation; a replayed, mismatched, cross-role, or glob-widened authorization MUST be denied, and an absent, gapped, or digest-broken ledger MUST deny every authorization it holds.
rationale: ADR-AUT-0001 binds publication to a one-time exact grant. Possession of authorization bytes is not authority, and absence of a ledger is a failure to observe, never an absence of restriction (Article 41).

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
